name: Topologically Accurate Dual Isosurfacing
aliases: Trilinear Isosurfacing with Ambiguous Face Handling
definition: A method to determine the topology of an analytical isosurface within a voxel cell by using trilinear interpolation and resolving ambiguous faces to ensure topological correctness.
summary: Topologically Accurate Dual Isosurfacing extracts isosurfaces using trilinear interpolation, resolving ambiguous face configurations to guarantee topological correctness unlike standard Marching Cubes.
